censored_rows: dropped, which truncates the label distribution at the inactive end; the retained range is the model's applicability window
grade_edges: not derivable from this release: no row carries both a grade and a number, and no (compound, cell line) pair appears as both. Grades are an ordering only, for an interval-censored fit.
replicate_aggregation: geometric mean of DC50 per (compound, cell line)
